Dialogs.Dialog: Practice has been brutal lately...
Takane
Hehe, you look sleepy.
You've got so much energy, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...
Maybe it's experience？ I've been playing tennis longer, right？
That's true, but...
Geez, sit up straight. Hmm, maybe you lack basic stamina...
Ah... That could be the case.
What about jogging every day？
I'd rather use that time to sleep...
...Yeah, maybe you should sleep. You're a little dangerous like this.
(What should I do...)
Takane
▲主人公＊▲. What about trying a part-time job？
？ Where's this coming from？
Remember we talked about stamina？ When I mentioned it in class, someone said a part-time job builds it.
What kind of part-time jobs？
Hauling materials at construction sites, they said？ Or working for a moving company.
T-That's...
Impossible for you？
I guess...
I see... Maybe steady training is better after all？
(Yeah, I'll do that！)
Takane
I'm thinking of getting a new racket.
Why？
I've used it a long time... It's been acting up lately...
I see. ...What's wrong？
Well... I'm attached to that racket, so replacing it feels a little sad...
Ah... But replacing it doesn't mean throwing it away, right？
Yeah.
Then I don't think you need to feel so bad about it？
Why not go have a look for now？ There might be a good racket.
...Yeah, you're right. Hey, will you come look with me？
Sure. When should we go？
So, did you decide？
Takane
I think I'll replace it after all.
Ah, with the one you liked best？
Yes. It felt great in my hand when I tried it. Thank you for helping me decide.
No problem. What'll you do with the one you're using now？
Into the memory box, I guess？
Memory box？ What's in it？
Lots of stuff, since grade school. Writing boards I used to use, stickers I collected...
But maybe I'll keep it out for practice swings？ It's heavy, so it'd be good training.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ sure holds on to her things...)
Takane
I wonder if it's hard to balance club and studying.
Why？
A girl in another club was saying that in class.
She said after coming home exhausted from club, she doesn't feel like studying.
Ah, I get that.
Hey, maybe I'm still not practicing enough？
Huh？
Because I never come home so tired that I don't feel like doing anything. Doesn't that mean I'm not practicing enough？
Maybe I'll ask the captain to give me more, just me...
(She's already doing a ton... Amazing, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.)
Did practicing more pay off？
Takane
Yes... I get tired now, but not so tired I collapse when I get home？ So I'll stay late and do a little more...
No, no, no. Any more than that is too much.
Eh？ Why？
Overpracticing leads to injuries！
...Okay, but...
Most of all, it cuts into our time together！
If you put it like that, I...
...Okay. I'll go back to normal.
(...Phew.)
Takane
Hey, did you hear？ They might change our match uniforms.
Yeah, I also heard they're asking a famous designer. Wonder if it's true.
Really？ I hope that's true.
Huh... You care about that？
Hehe. Before, I don't think I'd have cared at all？
But now, if I could wear a cute uniform, I'd want to.
You'd like that better too, right？ ...Just kidding.
When will we find out, I wonder？ I want to hear more soon！
(...If she gets that shy, I'll get shy too.)
I heard more about the uniforms.
Takane
Oh, what happened？
It was true, but it fell through. Other clubs complained, "Why just the tennis club？"
I see. Sigh, too bad. Really...
By the way. I forgot to say this the other day.
Hmm？ What？
You're cute as you are, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
...Geez, saying that at a time like this is unfair...！
Hmph！
(Timing... Girls are hard...)
Takane
The other day when I went shopping, I ran into a girl I've played in matches a few times.
Huh, did you talk？
Yes, she started talking to me. She's really good at tennis... The first time we played, I couldn't do a thing.
What！ ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
I can laugh about it now, but it was rough afterward？ I was so frustrated.
I think I can kind of picture it...
Hehe. So the other day we traded info about how our schools practice.
I heard about some eye-opening training too, so I'm thinking of telling the captain.
Oh. A spy war？
Don't exaggerate. ...But I don't intend to lose the information war. Hehehe...
(She's not still holding a grudge about losing... right？)
Did you get any useful info out of your rival after that？
Takane
Yeah, well...
Huh, that's vague.
We talked about tennis, of course... and other stuff too...
Other things？
Um... about boyfriends...
Yes. And about the person she's going out with. So, an info exchange...
...Um？ What kind of stuff？
Well, you know, this and that？ ...Yeah, some other time！ Okay？
(This and that... What exactly...)
Takane
By the way, everyone got really into tennis terms the other day.
Oh yeah？ Like what？
Well, like there are a lot of people who say "single" instead of "singles".
Ah, people who aren't into it might mix that up.
Yes. Someone who started in high school said they only noticed after joining.
I guess it's natural that adding "s" to "single" feels weird.
We talked about lots more. Where "service" and "love" come from, and how hard "mizutori" is, sponging puddles off the court.
Hm？ "Mizutori" is a tennis term too？
Huh？ I thought so... Is it not？ I'll look it up and report back？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ really likes looking things up.)
Takane
Remember "mizutori"？ Turns out it isn't purely a tennis term.
Huh, really.
They do it when making rice-bran pickles, and in feng shui too, though that's a bit different.
You looked it up again. Thanks for going to the trouble.
Hehe, you're welcome.
Still, mizutori... I'd rather not do it if I can help it.
Hehe. Maybe that's part of what makes club fun, too？
Well, yeah？
But you still don't want to do it？
Right！
Geez, which is it？ Hehe！
Takane
Hey, will you come with me to the sports shop sometime？
Sure. What do you want to buy？
I'm thinking of getting new shoes. I could still wear these, but they're pretty worn down.
And while I'm at it, I'll get my racket restrung.
I see. Maybe I should change mine as well...
When was the last time you changed them？
...When was it？
Supposedly you should restring every three months...
...So I really should？
I think so...
But that's amazing. That you can play like that with them... I respect that. Really.
(She respects me for such a weird thing...)
Takane
So？ How does it feel after restringing？
It really is different. The ball has more life, I guess.
Hehe, good. It's hard to know when to restring, isn't it？
So ▲高嶺＊＊▲ restrings every three months？
That's the baseline. But the strings change depending on how you play, so more like whenever they need it.
So when you think it's time, it's time. For me, that might be a long way off...
Hehe, geez. If you're aiming for tournaments, shouldn't you stick to the basics？
I see. Then while we're in school, I'll restring when ▲高嶺＊＊▲ does.
...Only while we're in school？
Haha, sorry. I mean, even after we graduate, too.
Good answer. Just kidding. Hehe！
Takane
By the way, there was an old man watching us practice. Did you notice？
Ah, yeah. The guy who was smiling.
Maybe he knew someone？ A grandchild or something？
I think that old man was watching ▲高嶺＊＊▲, though.
Huh, really？ Hmm... I didn't recognize his face...
...Hehe.
Huh？
The way he moved his head following the ball was cute. Like a cat chasing a mirror reflection.
Ah, now that you mention it, it was like that.
Right？ He was gone before I noticed...
(So she doesn't know him. Was I wrong？)
By the way, you were talking with that old man at practice, right？ Did you know him？
Takane
No. He was there to watch me, but it was a mix-up.
Misunderstanding？
He has a granddaughter who looks a lot like me and plays tennis too, but it turned out she goes to another school.
Haha, he must have been surprised...
But she looks that much like ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Which school？
...I forgot.
Huh？
I forgot. So you can't go meet her. ...No, you mustn't. Got it？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is as easy to read as ever.)
...Your answer？
...Yes. Sorry.
Does hitting against a wall actually do anything？
Takane
Of course. If it doesn't, I think it means you're not doing it properly.
Urgh.
Hehe. You know that Japanese player who's doing so well overseas right now？
Yeah, the one who won an overseas tournament as the youngest ever...
Yes. Apparently as a kid he practiced against the wall all the time.
Huh... So it depends on how you do it.
I think so. You can check your form and work on control.
But if you just hit blindly, you can pick up bad habits, so you have to be careful.
...Wall practice runs deep.
Right, don't underestimate it.
(Maybe I'll put more effort into it next practice.)
Takane
So？ Did you try wall practice？
Yeah. It's pretty fun. Best of all, it's free.
Hehe. As long as there's a wall, you can do it anytime. What did you notice？
I feel like I get set up faster than before.
Uh-huh. What else？
What else... Oh, right. I'd like you to check my form sometime. It's been bugging me.
Sure. Maybe I'll do wall practice with you.
Oh, nice. A wall-practice date.
Do you want wall practice？ Or a date？
Both？
Geez, you're so greedy. Hehehe！
Takane
By the way, did you hear we might go on an away trip？
Yeah, I heard. Wonder if it's far？
I wonder if we'll go by bus. ...It'll be a bus, won't it？
Probably. Huh？ Are you bad with cars？
No. I don't get carsick... but tour buses are the one thing I just can't handle.
Tour buses do feel weirdly floaty. If it comes to that, you'll have to take motion sickness pills.
Huh, you can't take those either？
I can... but once I took one and got so sleepy I was dozing all day...
Sigh, what should I do. Maybe I'll go by train, just me？
(That'll be tough too... What can we do？)
By the way, about the away trip. Turns out it's a practice match in the next city.
Takane
Yes. We're going by train, so I'm relieved. But... I really need a plan, don't I？
Yeah. We might really go on a trip someday.
Yes... What do you think I should do？
I looked into it. Sit near the front of the bus, don't look at nearby scenery, and sunglasses help, apparently.
Really？
Yeah. Cutting down visual stimulation helps. There was also riding as if you were the driver.
As if I were the driver... Hey, could I train for that at the arcade？
Ah, with a driving game？ I wonder...
I want to try it once. Hey, will you take me？
S-Sure, I guess.
Thanks？ I'll definitely beat this...！
(If she can overcome her motion sickness by playing games, it'll be such an amazing discovery...)
By the way, weren't the girls' team arguing？
Takane
Yes... They're two girls who are usually close. They always pair up at practice.
They fell for the same person. And that started the fight.
Well, that's...
...If it were you they liked, I'm sure I'd have been in it too.
Eh!?
Before, I never understood how anyone could end up like that...
But if I thought someone was taking the person I love... I understand wanting to fight.
I really hope they make up？ But I don't think it'll happen right away...
...To think I'd come to understand things like this. Love is something, isn't it？
(Don't look so sad...)
...Hey. What happened with that fight？
Takane
Yes. Looks like they made up.
That fast！ How？
They both confessed and both got turned down. Apparently they knew neither of them had a chance...
So they wanted to get it over with. And they made up.
O-Oh, really. Girls are kind of mysterious...
Hehe. But I'm glad they made up. I'm glad my hunch was wrong...
Sorry for saying something weird the other day. I'd be happy if you forgot it.
...It's fine, don't worry about it.
Thank you. Now, let's go home？
(I never want to see ▲高嶺＊＊▲ look that sad again...)
Did you hear？ Suzuki-sensei, our advisor, his wife's about to give birth.
Takane
Yes！ He's been so restless lately, right？ Now I know why, which is a relief.
Hahaha. He's been so distracted lately.
Hehe. Right now we're talking about giving him a secret present.
Oh, sounds fun.
Right？ I wonder if the boys' team would join in.
Then I'll ask the captain.
Okay, please.
Sure. Suzuki-sensei might cry, huh？ From being so moved.
He's strict but sentimental, right？ I'm kind of looking forward to his reaction.
By the way, Suzuki-sensei cried after all.
Takane
Yes. I cried along with him.
Some guys on the boys' team did too.
And what about you, saying that？
Hmm, who knows？
Hehe, it's fine. I won't ask.
But a husband like that would be nice. Someday, I'll...
Hm？
Nothing！ Maybe because we gave him the present before practice, practice wasn't hard today, was it？
Yeah. I bet it'll be extra tough next time to make up for it.
Hehe！ Let's work hard so we don't lose to Sensei's happy power？
Okay！
